:::{#exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision}
#### Hessian contribution of one binary outcome in terms of the precision and deviation

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution,
write the [Hessian](#def-hessian) contribution $\hess_\iobs(\prob)$
using the [precision](#def-precision-rv) $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$
and the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) $\devn_\iobs \eqdef \outvar_\iobs - \prob$,
the two quantities that make up the [score](#def-score) contribution in @thm-bernoulli-score-contribution.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision}

Starting from @thm-bernoulli-hessian-contribution,
substitute $\outvar_\iobs = \prob + \devn_\iobs$ and $1 - \outvar_\iobs = 1 - \prob - \devn_\iobs$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
&= -\frac{\outvar_\iobs}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1 - \outvar_\iobs}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(the contribution from the theorem above)}\\
&= -\frac{\prob + \devn_\iobs}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1 - \prob - \devn_\iobs}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(substitute $\outvar_\iobs = \prob + \devn_\iobs$)}\\
&= -\frac{1}{\prob} - \frac{\devn_\iobs}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1}{1 - \prob} + \frac{\devn_\iobs}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(split each numerator and cancel one factor)}\\
&= -\paren{\frac{1}{\prob} + \frac{1}{1 - \prob}} - \devn_\iobs \paren{\frac{1}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}}
&& \text{(collect the terms with and without $\devn_\iobs$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The first bracket is the [precision](#def-precision-rv):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{1}{\prob} + \frac{1}{1 - \prob}
&= \frac{1 - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)} + \frac{\prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(common denominator)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(add the numerators)}\\
&= \precision
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The second bracket is a multiple of $\precision^2$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{1}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}
&= \frac{\sqf{1 - \prob}}{\sqf{\prob} \sqf{1 - \prob}} - \frac{\sqf{\prob}}{\sqf{\prob} \sqf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(common denominator)}\\
&= \frac{1 - 2 \prob + \sqf{\prob} - \sqf{\prob}}{\sqf{\prob(1 - \prob)}}
&& \text{(expand $\sqf{1 - \prob}$ and add the numerators)}\\
&= \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \frac{1}{\sqf{\prob(1 - \prob)}}
&& \text{(simplify the numerator)}\\
&= \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \sqf{\precision}
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting both brackets back in:

$$
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
= -\precision - \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \sqf{\precision} \devn_\iobs
\qquad \text{(substitute the two brackets)}
$$

:::
